zh.decision_text: 【继承大业】屋大维以恺撒继承人身份返回罗马。安东尼控制着恺撒的国库和军团，元老院对这位年轻的继承人充满猜忌。首要任务是利用恺撒之名在坎帕尼亚招募老兵，同时以恺撒遗嘱承诺的遗赠争取罗马平民支持。

commands.reasoning: 以恺撒之名在坎帕尼亚招募老兵
暂时联合元老院对抗安东尼
筹措资金兑现恺撒对平民的遗赠承诺

en.decision_text: Octavian returns to Rome as Caesar's adopted heir. Antony holds Caesar's treasury and legions — the Senate distrusts this young upstart. First priority: recruit Caesar's veterans in Campania using the Caesar name, and win the Roman plebs with Caesar's promised legacy.

commands.reasoning: Use Caesar's name to recruit veterans in Campania
Temporarily ally with Senate against Antony
Raise funds to fulfill Caesar's legacy to the plebs

zh.decision_text: 【巩固西方】安东尼控制着罗马城、高卢和西班牙行省。声称要为恺撒复仇，实则巩固自身权力。命军团在高卢招募新兵，修复与元老院的关系以换取合法地位。同时密切关注屋大维在罗马的一举一动。

commands.reasoning: 高卢是安东尼的权力根基
与元老院维持表面和平，稳固合法地位
集结兵力于山南高卢，威慑罗马

en.decision_text: Antony holds Rome, Gaul, and Hispania. He claims to avenge Caesar while consolidating his own power. Legions recruit fresh troops in Gaul. He seeks a fragile peace with the Senate for legitimacy — while watching Octavian's every move.

commands.reasoning: Gaul is Antony's power base
Keep surface peace with Senate for legitimacy
Mass troops in Cisalpine Gaul to threaten Rome

zh.decision_text: 【纵横捭阖】克利奥帕特拉巩固埃及统治后，将目光投向混乱的罗马。派遣使团携埃及谷物前往罗马，分别拜会安东尼和屋大维，试探谁能成为埃及的新保护者。同时扩建亚历山大港舰队，控制东地中海航线。

commands.reasoning: 塞浦路斯是东地中海海军前哨
安东尼手握重兵，是最有实力的保护者
扩充军团以增加外交筹码

en.decision_text: Cleopatra has secured Egypt. Now she turns her gaze to the chaos in Rome. Grain-laden ships sail to Italy bearing gifts — envoys visit both Antony and Octavian, probing which Roman can best protect Egypt. The Alexandrian fleet expands to control Eastern Mediterranean sea lanes.

commands.reasoning: Cyprus is the naval outpost of the Eastern Mediterranean
Antony commands the most legions — the strongest protector
Expand legions to increase diplomatic leverage

zh.decision_text: 【重组共和】元老院在刺杀恺撒后重获权力，控制着马其顿、希腊、叙利亚和小亚细亚等东方行省。西塞罗主导重组元老院，宣布安东尼和屋大维均为国家公敌，号召各行省起兵勤王。同时在马其顿招募军团备战。

commands.reasoning: 马其顿是元老院的军事基地
警告屋大维不得效仿恺撒称帝
发展小亚细亚行省经济以充军资

en.decision_text: The Senate reclaims power after Caesar's assassination, controlling Macedonia, Greece, Syria, and Asia Minor. Cicero declares both Antony and Octavian enemies of the Republic, calling the provinces to arms. Legions are raised in Macedonia.

commands.reasoning: Macedonia is the Senate's military stronghold
Warn Octavian against following Caesar's path to dictatorship
Develop Asia Minor's economy to fund the war
